description: This file defines the BasketViewModel class for the web application's basket page, including properties for basket ID, items, buyer ID, and a method to calculate the total price of items.

classes.name: BasketViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel representing a shopping basket with properties for basket details and total calculation.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price of items in the basket, rounded to two decimal places.
